title: Masked Library
description: A library mod for some of my creations + patreon supporter cosmetics and features
body:
# Masked Library
[![Fabric API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/intergrav/devins-badges/refs/heads/v3/assets/cozy/requires/fabric-api_64h.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
[![Patreon](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/intergrav/devins-badges/refs/heads/v3/assets/cozy/donate/patreon-singular_64h.png)](https://www.patreon.com/cw/Masked404)

## Description
Masked Library is a mod that I made to help with code transfering between random projects and to give my patreon supporters a little extra thank you with cosmetics and supporter features.


### Note
You will have to join the supporter discord (only available through patreon) to recieve patreon supporter features (including cosmetics)

ALSO: This mode is bound to change at the whimsy of my decisions, Cosmetics may change, or even be removed if I so please. No matter what, you will still keep your supporter status if you are in the discord, otherwise the API won't be able to tell. If you lose your supporter status, that is my fault as I suck at coding.

### Mods that will use this
- Soul Ban (when it releases, supporter command/feature)
- Maybe some other stuff idk

# Credits
HEAVY credits to [Doctor4t](https://modrinth.com/user/RAT) (RAT) for inspiring this mod, RAT's mod [Ratatouille](https://modrinth.com/mod/ratatouille) is what gave me the idea for this mod, although my spaghetti code is nothing compared to how great RAT's mods are. If you like this mod (and some of my other ones) please go check out RAT and possibly [Luxintrus](https://modrinth.com/user/Luxintrus) if you like [horse necromancy](https://www.patreon.com/cw/Luxintrus). These people are much better at modding and art than I'll ever be.
